cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Prove We’re Close
cards.instruction: Get someone to take a social or emotional risk that demonstrates trust in the connection.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Come to the reunion with me. Let them see us arrive holding hands.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They still think we're just friends.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I know. I want us to trust each other in that room too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Last time someone asked, you let go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll introduce you as my partner. Will you keep hold while I say it?

mechanism: A copies apparent social ease without understanding it and asks B for a risky sign of trust, accepting a reciprocal exposure when B asks.
confusable: D73 company is insufficient; D80 requires a social or emotional risk as proof of trust.
comparison: Public recognition at reunion versus sending a vulnerable message.
seedUse: Preserve B memory of past retreat and request for A vulnerability before asking B again.
